title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + enrich audit logs
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Context: Customers in regulated regions require strict data residency guarantees and cryptographic key locality. The RBAC v2 policy engine previously supported KMS key scoping but did not consistently enforce region residency constraints at evaluation time nor did it surface key/region details in audit logs. This PR adds enforcement for KMS region pinning at policy-evaluation time, augments audit logging with key metadata and region context, and provides a migration path and feature flag to roll the change out.

d4e5f6g: audit: include kms_key_id, kms_key_region, and kms_policy_source in audit payloads
h7i8j9k: api: expose region_residency field on CreateKeyRequest + validation

p3q4r5s: tests: unit+integration for region pinning and audit enrichment
review_comments: Ethan Cole: Left a suggestion — can we short-circuit evaluation for system roles to avoid perf regression? Also add a microbenchmark (suggested change).
Author (Sofia Martinez): Replied with benchmark results — added microbenchmark and a cache layer for resolved key metadata which mitigates the hotspot (see new test commit).
Priya Nair: Requested clearer migration steps for existing role bindings that lack region fields; asked for a rollout flag and a 2-week auto-audit window before enforcement.
Author: Added feature flag 'rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce' and an opt-in migration job that annotates existing bindings; updated docs with migration steps.
Liam O'Connor: Approved after CI green and integration tests covering cross-region fallback policies.
ci_checks: perf-microbench: pass (latency +1.8% on worst-case path, mitigated by key metadata cache)
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 and enrich audit logs with kms_key_id and kms_key_region. Feature-gated rollout; see docs for migration steps.
notes_on_migration: Ship strategy: 1) Enable audit enrichment immediately (no enforcement) to collect kms_key_region on existing requests. 2) Run migration job (provided) to annotate role bindings that already meet residency constraints. 3) After 14 days of audit monitoring, flip feature flag rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce in canary, then global. The migration job is idempotent and logs affected bindings to Linear ENG-4821 for review.
summary: Adds runtime enforcement of KMS region pinning to RBAC v2, audit log enrichment, admin console controls, and migration tooling. Backwards compatible behind feature flag; includes tests and perf mitigations.
